title: Design System: Slow Down on Victory Lakes Loop

display.purpose: Page H1; centred in the title block.

headline.purpose: Section H2s, usually a ruled heading.

body.purpose: All public reading text, 17px; prose capped at 68ch.

lettering.purpose: osifont site name in the header, uppercase.

lettering-title.purpose: The LEGEND title, uppercase and underlined; sheet-note titles use the same voice at 1.15rem, 0.05em.

action.purpose: The primary action only; uppercase with a 0.45px text stroke.

tally.purpose: Household count in the legend; 1.85rem on phones; 0.4px text stroke.

shadows.name: popup
shadows.purpose: Address combobox listbox, the one thing that floats over the form (dark: rgb(0 0 0 / 0.8)).

shadows.name: sheet-on-table
shadows.purpose: Dark mode only: the plat's light sheet lying on the dark drafting table.

motion.name: ease-draw
motion.purpose: Expo-out for the scale-bar draw-in, button press and arrow nudge.

motion.name: scale-draw-in
motion.value: 1100ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) 200ms both; scaleX(0.02) to scaleX(1), origin left
motion.purpose: The legend's hatched fill draws in once; the only entrance motion.

breakpoints.name: narrow
breakpoints.purpose: Legend key column stacks over the tally; primary action tightens.

breakpoints.name: phone
breakpoints.purpose: Primary layout; first-sheet rule (plat, title block, legend, action within 844px).

breakpoints.name: tablet
breakpoints.purpose: Three-part header; lower sections in two columns.

breakpoints.name: desktop
breakpoints.purpose: Plat left, title block and legend right; sheet notes as a four-column strip.

lineWeights.name: pen-rule
lineWeights.purpose: Frames, controls, ruled headings, sheet-note box.

lineWeights.name: inner-rule
lineWeights.purpose: Inner line of every double rule; row dividers.

lineWeights.name: dashed-rule
lineWeights.purpose: Reasons separators; notices use 1.5px dashed var(--rule).

textures.name: paper-texture
textures.purpose: Film grain on the public page ground; dropped in dark mode and the admin.

textures.name: pencil-vermilion
textures.purpose: Red-pencil shading on the primary action.

narrative.overview:
The petition is about our own streets, so every page is a sheet of the neighborhood plat. The ground is cool drafting film with a faint paper grain; everything is drawn in navy pen; one vermilion pencil line marks the boundary, and that same colour marks the one thing to do. The site's parts are the sheet's parts: a title block for the headline, a legend for the count and the action, numbered sheet notes for the county process, a scale bar for progress. Nothing is a card, a hero or a badge.

Density is calm and generous on the public pages (17px body, 44px section gaps, a single reading column on phones) and tighter in the admin, which is the same sheet set for work. The world refuses the petition-platform template (photo hero, solid red progress bar, a row of equal cards) and refuses anything that could read as an official county, VDOT or HOA document: there are no seals, crests or agency logos, only the three-ripple lake mark.

Imagery is drawn, never photographed: the plat itself, two small pen illustrations (a school bus with walking children, a car with speed lines), and two texture plates (the film ground and the vermilion pencil shading). Every shipping raster carries its provenance prompt.
keyCharacteristics: Drafting-film paper, navy pen linework, one vermilion boundary colour.
Containers are pen-ruled frames: a double rule with crop ticks at the corners, never a rounded card.
Three voices of type: engineering lettering (osifont) for the sheet's labels and the action, Barlow Semi Condensed for headings, Barlow for reading.
Flat sheet; depth comes from pen weight, not shadow.
Dark mode is a light sheet lying on a dark drafting table.
Strict CSP shapes the craft: no inline styles or scripts; geometry lives in SVG attributes, colour in CSS.

rules.name: The One Boundary Rule
rules.body: Vermilion is the boundary line, and only things that belong to the boundary or call for a hand may wear it: the boundary and its key swatch, the scale fill, the one primary action, the "we are here" marker, focus and errors. Checked controls, the active option, the caret and the link-hover underline echo it at hairline weight. Never use it for a heading, a background, an icon, a decorative line or a second accent.

rules.name: The Navy Pen Rule
rules.body: Every line, letter and icon is drawn in the one navy ink (or its light-ink counterpart in dark mode). No greys, no black, no second ink colour. The county print view is the one exception.

rules.name: The Light Sheet Rule
rules.body: In dark mode the page becomes a dark drafting table, but the plat keeps its light sheet: 12px of sheet margin, 3px corners, and a soft drop shadow beneath it. Pen-drawn rasters swap to their light-ink variants through `<picture>` sources keyed on `prefers-color-scheme`. The plat's caption keeps the light sheet's faded ink.

rules.name: The Lettering Rule
rules.body: osifont is the sheet's hand: it sets the site name, the legend, key and sheet-note titles, the tally, the scale labels, the plat caption and the primary action. Nothing else. Headings are Barlow Semi Condensed 600; reading text, form inputs and labels' helper text are Barlow.

rules.name: The Floor Rule
rules.body: Reading text is never smaller than 16px; the body is 17px. Lettering that has to be read (captions, keys, fine print) obeys the same floor.

rules.name: The First Sheet Rule
rules.body: On a phone the plat, its caption, the title block, the legend and the primary action all land inside the first 844px. Anything added above the legend must earn its height against that line.

rules.name: The Weight Budget Rule
rules.body: A public page weighs under 150KB, not counting Turnstile. The four fonts (about 75KB) and the plat (17KB at 420w, 40KB at 840w) are most of that already; a new raster has to be palette-quantized to fit.

rules.name: The Pen-Weight Rule
rules.body: Depth is drawn, not cast: 2px closes the page, 1.5px draws a part, 1px or dashed divides inside it. A shadow is allowed only on something that physically lifts off the sheet.

rules.name: The Crop Tick Rule
rules.body: Only the important parts of a sheet get the full double rule with crop ticks: the title block, the legend, the first lower section, the petition statement and the signing form. Later sections open with a top double rule alone so the page can breathe. Content pages (FAQ, privacy, thanks, withdraw) use the double rule without ticks.

dos: Do draw every container as a part of the sheet: a 1.5px pen rule with a 1px soft rule inset 4px, crop ticks 9px past the corners for the parts that matter, a top double rule alone for the rest.
Do caption the plat, every time it appears, with "Illustration only. The county sets the real petition area."
Do keep reading text at 16px or larger (body is 17px) and every target at least 44px tall (the primary action is 58px, fields 50px, secondary buttons 48px).
Do set SVG geometry with attributes and all colour with CSS classes; the CSP allows no inline styles and no inline scripts.
Do keep the plat on its light sheet in dark mode, and ship a light-ink `-dark` variant for every pen-drawn raster, swapped with a `<picture>` source.
Do draw icons from the authored set (24 grid, 1.75 stroke, `currentColor`, `aria-hidden`), or add to it in the same hand.
Do embed the generation or derivation prompt in every shipping raster and palette-quantize it before it ships.
Do keep a public page under 150KB, not counting Turnstile.
Do honour `prefers-reduced-motion` by turning off every animation and transition; the scale-bar draw-in is the only entrance motion.
donts: Don't use vermilion outside the One Boundary Rule: no vermilion headings, backgrounds, icons, decorative lines or second accent colour.
Don't set body copy, headings or form labels in osifont; it is lettering for labels, the tally, the scale, the caption and the action only.
Don't label anything on the plat except Victory Lakes Loop, invent street or lake names, or present the drawing as the real petition area.

Don't put an eyebrow or kicker label above a heading. Lettered uppercase belongs to the sheet's own parts (site name, legend title, key, sheet-note titles, scale), which are the label, not a preface to one.
Don't use Unicode glyphs (★, ✓, →, ▸) as icons.
Don't add county, VDOT or HOA seals, logos or anything that looks like an official crest; the ripple mark is the only mark.
Don't round frames or float them on shadows; only the combobox popup and the dark-mode plat sheet may cast one.
Don't fall back to the petition-platform template: a photo hero, a solid red progress bar, a row of equal cards.
